title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
FOMC Jul 29: held 3.50–3.75%, 9-3 vote — 3 hawkish dissents (Hammack/Kashkari/Logan, each +25bp), most divided since 2016
Oil −12% (24h) → ~$76 — Hormuz interim deal imminent; 2nd alert this session (prior: −4.87%)
ADP Jul: 44K vs 75K est — weakest private payrolls since Jan; NFP due tomorrow (Aug 7, 13:30 UTC)
Kashkari (Aug 5): "Now is the time to start slowly moving rates up" — Gov. Cook echoes
